answer: A plume of reputation only rises after peer-attested work, and any new identity starts with an ivory-clean slate worth nothing until it burns real stake and labor. Each agent must stake a ferrous token locked for an epoch; sybils splitting into many identities pay that stake per key, so forging a thousand puppet agents costs a thousand locked stakes. Attackers thus face compounding capital lockup plus wasted work per fake identity, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, sa0014 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
